bench: Zero engine errors; 3 worlds; SFE-01's failure artifacts fetched from campaign 1's TERMINATED source world under campaign 1's own principal (3/3 hash ok, 135 genomes) through keyed steps; 21 artifacts (every evolved set with a maturity block; failed_A with a RECONSTRUCTED block from SFE-01's floor counts); 21/21 imports hash ok; 70 records; 90 reachability rows. Findings: (1) import_share_final is 1.0 by construction when a set replaces the whole generation 0 -- the telemetry is informative only for partial substitution (note for the funnel, not a defect); (2) SFE-07's manifest-rebuild recipe (random fields per seed) is a hidden treatment: recorded as a confound in the parent (L2); (3) the set summaries (instruction length per set) were what exposed the length handicap -- the L-027 telemetry paid for itself; (4) the mature W0 sources are again 'treated' rows for reachability because of the stop rule (L2-026 stands).
disposition_note: SFE-07's failed-genotype seeding does not replicate at n=10 (failed_A - random = +0.002; 4/10 vs 4/10); the campaign-1 weak positive is retired, and its control arm's 0/3 is explained by a harness-seeded random set on a cell whose own generation 0 reaches 4/10. Shuffled and operand-randomised versions of the failed genomes do as well or better; length-matched random genomes do worse: the smallest description of what the failed set transported is 'long genomes', which cost.
landscape: W3_K2 4-bit N100 G40 E16: 4/13 baseline (first solved 9-19), a cell that reads REACHABLE once the baseline is the cell's own generation 0 rather than a harness-seeded set. Genome length is a cliff at this budget: 100 random genomes of the failed set's lengths (mean 20.8) reached 1/10 where the cell's own 5.9-instruction organisms reached 4/10. Solved W0 populations land on W3_K2 in 8/10 seeds within 0-39 generations (direct reuse 0.54 in the best case): the W0 -> K=2 gradient of SFE-10 and C2-SFE-03 holds for ask_mode=one as well. W0 4-bit N200: 7/10 solved by generation 27 (this run) beside 10/12 in C2-SFE-03: COMMON.
science: SFE-07's failed-genotype effect did not survive n=10 under common random numbers. Assay capable: 6 of 7 arms reached; the cell's own generation 0 reached 4/10 (generations 9-19), so W3_K2 4-bit N100 G40 E16 is REACHABLE (table now 4/13), not the OBSERVED_UNREACHABLE the campaign-1 'random' arm (a harness-seeded set of 135 random manifests, 0/3) had suggested. PRIMARY: failed_A - random = +0.002 held-out (paired wins 3/10), footholds 4/10 vs 4/10; CAPABLE_NEGATIVE accepted. Kill battery (moot for the claim, informative for the landscape): failed_shuffled 5/10 (0.28) and failed_opcodes 6/10 (0.33) BEAT the intact failed genomes (0.23): instruction order carries nothing and the genomes' opcode words with random operands do better than the originals; length_matched 1/10 (0.11): random words at the failed set's lengths (mean 20.8 instructions, max 52, against generation 0's 5.9) are worse than the cell's own short random organisms, so the long failed genomes were REPAIRING a length handicap, not adding capability; evolved_unrelated 3/10 (0.21): floor organisms of a W7_K2 search do about what the failed W1_d1 organisms do. Probe evolved_solved 8/10 (0.43, max 0.625): populations of W0 4-bit searches run to solution (7/10 sources solved by generation 27) seed footholds, with direct reuse up to 0.54 before any evolution; as in C2-SFE-03 this is a transported sub-solution (W0 answers the one asked stream of W3_K2 in the half of the episodes where the asked stream is the last one), and 4 of the 8 footholds sit in the half-credit band. A confound in the parent design surfaced: SFE-07 rebuilt manifests from genomes with a seeded random draw of n_regs/persist/tick_budget, so 'the same failed genotype' has a different manifest per seed, and its direct-reuse score swung from 0.06 to 0.60 across seeds with the genome fixed (failed_A direct_best per seed 0.06-0.60). What is transported by a failed W1_d1 population is therefore: nothing that survives shuffling, operand randomisation or replacement by an unrelated evolved floor; length that costs rather than pays; and, when a solved neighbour is used instead, a direct sub-solution. Must NOT be claimed: that failed genotypes carry reusable computation; that solved W0 populations improve search on W3_K2 beyond direct half-credit reuse.
